summary: Backend regression after .env.example fix + GROQ_API_KEY=KSt2Po. All 4 env files exist. Gitignore whitelist verified via `git check-ignore`: /app/backend/.env.example and /app/frontend/.env.example are NOT ignored (exit 1); /app/backend/.env and /app/frontend/.env ARE ignored (exit 0). /api/transcribe with a valid tiny WAV now returns 500 'Transcription failed: Error code: 401 - Invalid API Key' instead of 'GROQ_API_KEY missing' — confirms env var is picked up by the backend. Full pytest suite: 20 passed, 1 skipped (the missing-key test correctly skips when key is configured). Updated the transcribe tests to probe backend-side key configuration via a live request instead of the test-process env, so the suite is deterministic regardless of where pytest is invoked from.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py load_dotenv path is implicit; backend picks up /app/backend/.env correctly after supervisor restart — verified live.
gitignore now uses both `.env.*` and `*.env` patterns plus three explicit `!` whitelist lines for .env.example — order is correct (whitelists come after the exclude patterns).
seed_data_creation: None. Existing test data is prefixed TEST_ per convention.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend GROQ_API_KEY is intentionally a fake value (KSt2Po). /api/transcribe will always 500 with 'Transcription failed: ... Invalid API Key' until a real Groq key is provided. Tests self-probe backend key status via _backend_has_groq_key() helper. If a real key is later added, test_transcribe_synthetic_wav may return 200 — already handled by the (200,500) branch.

verification_details.transcribe_live_probe: POST /api/transcribe with valid WAV -> 500 {"detail":"Transcription failed: Error code: 401 - {'error': {'message': 'Invalid API Key', 'type': 'invalid_request_error', 'code': 'invalid_api_key'}}"} — confirms env var pickup.
